Objective: make the tests from the RED task pass without weakening any assertion. Rule `KW-ARB-MODE-001` and `KW-ARB-READY-001` read facts nothing sets, no return is recorded, and a return cannot be joined to its dispatch once headers are stripped.

Files (path - symbol):
- `src/KyberWeave.Core/Arbiter/Rules/default-rules.yml` - rule `KW-ARB-MODE-001` only
- `src/KyberWeave.Core/Arbiter/Facts/ArbiterLedgerEvent.cs` - `ArbiterReturnMarkers`, doc on `PairDigest`

- `src/KyberWeave.Arbiter/Hooks/Adapters/ClaudeHookAdapter.cs` - `HandlePost`, `HandleHandback`

Rule: in `KW-ARB-MODE-001`, replace the clause `{ fact: ledger.red-evidence, exists: true }` with `{ fact: plan.task, in: ledger.red-evidence }`. Change nothing else in that file.

`PlanTestContract` (new, namespace `KyberWeave.Core.Arbiter.Plans`): `Classify(PlanDocument plan, string planText, string resolvedPlanPath, string taskId)` returns `(string? RowFact, string? RefusalReason)`.
- No row for the task: `RowFact` null.
- Row not exempt: `RowFact` is the string `RED required`, never the raw cell.
- A row is exempt only when both cells agree: the `Test project or file` cell starts, ignoring case, with `no new test`, `no test`, `no-test`, `not applicable` or `n/a`; and the `RED evidence required` cell is `n/a`, `not applicable` or `none`.
- Exempt and approved: `Not applicable`. Exempt but not approved: `RED required`, with `RefusalReason` saying which condition failed.
- Approved means the first body line beginning `Status:`, with emphasis removed so `**Status:** Ready` and `**Status: Ready**` both match, starts with Ready, In progress or In-progress. With no such line, frontmatter `status` of `ready` or `in-progress` counts. A Draft or Blocked status never counts.
- When a task file sits beside the document (same path with `.md` replaced by `.tasks.json`) and has a JSON string `execution-digest`, it must equal `PlanDocumentParser.ExecutionDigest(plan)` ignoring case. Missing, unreadable or another shape gives no binding and no refusal.

Both `HookPlanReader.Enrich` and `ArbiterCliPlanReader.Enrich`: replace the boolean `plan.test-contract.row` with `RowFact`, and when `RefusalReason` is set add fact `evidence.KW-ARB-MODE-001` labelled derived.

`ArbiterReturnMarkers`: add optional trailing `[property: JsonPropertyName("tests-failed")] int? TestsFailed` and `[property: JsonPropertyName("commit")] string? Commit`.

`ArbiterReturnMarkerReader` (new): `Read(string? output, Func<string, bool> commitExists)` returns markers or null. Normalise CRLF. Take the last line-anchored match of each: `^RED_EVIDENCE:` (trimmed, capped at 500 characters); `^RESULT:\s+(PASS|FAIL)\b`, else `^STATUS:\s+(PASS|FAIL|ESCALATION)\b` mapped PASS to PASS and others to FAIL, into `TaskReview`; `^STATUS:\s+[A-Z_]+` into `PlannerStatus`; `^ATTESTED:` split on commas into `Attested`; `^TESTS:.*\bfailed=(\d+)\b` into `TestsFailed`; `^COMMIT:\s*([0-9a-fA-F]{7,64})\s*$` into `Commit` only when `commitExists` is true.

`ArbiterEvaluator.BuildLedgerEvent`: set `PairDigest` to the lowercase SHA-256 of `target + "\0" + HeaderBlock.Strip(prompt)` when the prompt is not empty. On the post phase set `Returns` from the reader, with `commitExists` calling `GitFacts.RefExists(ev.Cwd, sha)` when `ev.Cwd` is set and false otherwise.

`InFlightLedger`:
- `MatchPre`: when no pre matches by call id, `PairDigest` is null and `CallId` starts with `bg:`, return the `PreId` of the latest earlier post event with the same `CallId` and a non-null `PreId`. Latest, because a resumed session reuses the id.
- New overloads `RedEvidenceTasks(string planFile)` and `CompletedTasks(string planFile)`. Join each post to its pre by `PreId` and match the pre's `Headers.PlanFile` after trimming and normalising backslashes. Target class comes from `TriggerClassifier.TargetClassFor`. The parameterless overloads stay as they are.
- RED counts for the pre's `Headers.Task` only when the pre's target is `test-dev`, `RedEvidence` is not `none` (any case) and contains no template token (`<runner filter>`, `<failing tests>`, `<reason>`), `TestsFailed` is at least 1, and `Commit` is set.
- Complete counts only when the pre's target class is `implementation` and `TaskReview` is `PASS`.
- `Attested` entries `<task>=red` and `<task>=complete` count only when the pre's target class is `planner`.

`LedgerFacts.Enrich(facts, ledger, classification)` (new), called in `EvaluateDispatchAsync` right after `GateReportFacts.Enrich`, only when the bag contains `ledger.red-evidence`. With `PLAN_FILE` and `plan.task` known:
- `ledger.red-evidence` becomes a one-item list holding `plan.task` when the RED set for that `PLAN_FILE` intersects the task and its `plan.task.depends-on` (direct dependencies only). Otherwise it stays null, never empty.
- `ledger.completed-tasks` becomes `plan.task.depends-on` intersected with the completed set for that `PLAN_FILE`.
- Set `evidence.KW-ARB-MODE-001` when not credited, unless a reason is already set: name the task, the `PLAN_FILE`, the tasks that could supply RED, and for each the reason its latest `test-dev` return did not count, or that no return was recorded. Say that on Factory a finished worker must be read with `TaskOutput`.
- Set `evidence.KW-ARB-READY-001` naming the dependencies not recorded complete.

`AppendDecisionAsync`: add a final `ArbiterFactSet facts` parameter, passed by both callers. In the step-0 loop set `Evidence` from `evidence.<rule id>` when the value is a string and the effect is not allow. Leave the rest of the method unchanged, because pull request #562, still in progress, edits the `Repeat` line.

`IContextualHookDecisionEngine.RecordBackgroundLaunch`: a default no-op method with parameters `(string harness, string? target, string prompt, string launchId, HookContext context, string? sessionId)`. `ArbiterHookDecisionEngine` implements it by appending one post-phase ledger event with `CallId` `bg:<launchId>`, the same `PairDigest`, target and session, and no rule evaluation. Move the digest into one internal helper shared with `BuildLedgerEvent`.

`FactoryHookAdapter`:
- `IsPassThrough` on `PostToolUse`: `TaskOutput` passes through unless its response text has a line `Status: completed`.
- `HandlePost` for `TaskOutput`: take text from `tool_response` (a string, or all string values of an object or array joined by newlines), take `tool_input.task_id`, and call `DecidePost` with target null, an empty prompt and call id `bg:<task_id>`.
- `HandlePost` for `Task`: when the response text has a line `task_id: <id>`, pass `bg:<id>` as the call id. Otherwise null, as today.

`ClaudeHookAdapter`: on `async_launched` with an `agentId`, also call `RecordBackgroundLaunch` when the engine is contextual. In `HandleHandback` pass `bg:<agent_id>` as the call id.

`PlanDocument`: correct the `RedEvidenceRequired` remark, which claims MODE-001 takes the cell directly.

- `scripts/proc-guard.sh run -- dotnet test tests/KyberWeave.Tests/KyberWeave.Tests.csproj -c Release --no-build --filter "FullyQualifiedName~KyberWeave.Tests.Arbiter.ArbiterRedEvidenceFlowTests|FullyQualifiedName~KyberWeave.Tests.Arbiter.ArbiterMode001RuleTests|FullyQualifiedName~KyberWeave.Tests.Arbiter.FactoryHookAdapterTests|FullyQualifiedName~KyberWeave.Tests.Arbiter.ClaudeHandbackTests|FullyQualifiedName~KyberWeave.Tests.Arbiter.ClaudeHookAdapterTests|FullyQualifiedName~KyberWeave.Tests.Arbiter.ArbiterUnobservableReturnsTests|FullyQualifiedName~KyberWeave.Tests.Arbiter.ArbiterLedgerTests|FullyQualifiedName~KyberWeave.Tests.Arbiter.ArbiterDefaultRulesTests|FullyQualifiedName~KyberWeave.Tests.Arbiter.ArbiterExistsFalseRuleTests|FullyQualifiedName~KyberWeave.Tests.Arbiter.ArbiterRealEngineTests"`
